title: UH Faculty Feature Highlights Design for Aging
summary: A UH faculty profile looks at the people and design questions behind Park's work on aging and interactive technology.

sources.label: Read Chorong Park's original LinkedIn post

paragraphs.text: A University of Houston faculty feature offers a closer look at Chorong Park's approach to designing technology with aging and disabled communities. Park shared the September profile on October 28, 2025.
The article places her work on immersive experiences, AI agents, and social robots within the Hines College's growing focus on user experience design.

Its emphasis on participation connects those different technologies: people help shape the design, rather than simply test the result. That distinction makes the profile as much about how research happens as what gets built.
